captions: In the Weißensee School of Art there is a room exactly one square meter in size. It
is as wide and as deep as its entrance door, but almost twice as high. Since 2019,
this space has been a gallery that literally has no room for barriers.
Bender was brought to life with the ulterior motive of teaching students of visual
communication the role of graphic designers as curators. The question was
always how the specifics of the space can favour the artistic work.
Announcement Posters: Daedalus by Benedikt Weishaupt,
225 by Quang Duck Nguyeng and Anna Bierler
